purpose: Test whether the consumed V80 rank failure can be explained by isotropic two-point amplitude alone or by conditional-mean-quartile heteroscedasticity before authorizing any conditional non-Gaussian model. Fit every evaluated query only from the other 31 consumed truth residuals in its domain.

common.truth_residual: truth minus conditional mean followed by exact per-cube DC subtraction
common.LOO_fit: For query q, use truth residuals of the other 31 queries in the same domain only.
common.periodic_spectrum: Unwindowed rfftn; shells are nearest integer multiples of the box fundamental mode through the three-dimensional corner; fitted value is mean squared Fourier amplitude per shell and mode.
common.draw: Generate real-space standard Gaussian white noise, subtract DC, rfftn, multiply each mode by sqrt(LOO fitted mode power / 64^3), set DC to zero, irfftn, and subtract numerical DC.
common.pairing: Both controls use the identical stationary Gaussian draw for every domain, query, and member.

fixed_controls.stationary: Use the domain/query LOO isotropic Gaussian residual without another transform.
fixed_controls.quartile_scale: Stable-sort the evaluated query conditional mean into four exact equal-count strata; fit truth-residual RMS per stratum from the other 31 queries relative to their own strata; multiply the shared stationary draw by stratum RMS divided by LOO global RMS and restore DC.

frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.rank_and_coverage: For each baseline and domain, use the exact V75 17-label table and 99,999 SHA/label-derived relabelings. Report rank-TV and finite-ensemble coverage-deviation conditional p-values.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.stationary_compatible: All six stationary p-values, two per domain, are strictly greater than 1/240.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.quartile_scale_compatible: All six quartile-scale p-values are strictly greater than 1/240.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.branch_1: If stationary is compatible, do not authorize a conditional flow; two-point Gaussian rank calibration is sufficient as a low-cost control.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.branch_2: If stationary fails and quartile-scale is compatible, do not authorize a conditional flow yet; conditional heteroscedastic structure is required but Gaussianity is sufficient.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.branch_3: If both fail, record that a conditional non-Gaussian model such as a conditional flow is warranted for design, but do not automatically train it.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.spectral_metrics: Report the same four Hann-windowed residual-power and descriptive phase bands as V82A; they do not override the exact rank/coverage branch.
frozen_diagnostics_and_decision.truth_nonGaussianity: Report truth residual mean, RMS, skewness, and excess kurtosis by conditional-mean quartile as explanatory consumed evidence.

authorization.user_instruction: The user approved the Fable sequence and automatic progression with '그렇게 진행해'. V82A's frozen automatic next step explicitly authorizes a consumed-only Gaussian control.
